title: Agent chat P1: foundation — AI SDK v6 + OpenRouter client + settings (API key + model selector)
description: Build the foundation for a fully CLIENT-SIDE (no server) agent chat pane in Dash. This phase: dependencies + OpenRouter LLM client + settings/persistence + model selector. Stack per approved plan: Vercel AI SDK v6 (newest, has the built-in Agent harness) + @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider v2.x (the v6-compatible major). zod already present. (1) Add deps to packages/authoring-ui: pnpm add ai@^6 @openrouter/ai-sdk-provider@^2 (confirm exact compatible versions at install; v6 pairs with provider 2.x). (2) Create a client module packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/openrouterClient.ts: createOpenRouter({apiKey, headers:{ 'HTTP-Referer','X-Title':'Dash Agent' }}); a function to fetch the model list from GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (with the key) for the selector; expose helper to get a model handle by id. (3) Persistence: extend packages/authoring-ui/src/preferences.ts with openrouterApiKey?:string and agentModel?:string (localStorage, mirror existing pattern). (4) Settings UI piece (can be a small component used by the panel later): API-key input with a clear/remove button and a 'stored locally in this browser' notice; model selector dropdown populated from the live model list (graceful fallback if no key). VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green; authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); add a unit test for preferences round-trip + model-list parsing (mock fetch). Do NOT build the chat loop/panel yet (later phases). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file + package.json/lockfile; push rebase-retry. Scope: new agentchat/ module + preferences.ts + package.json.
